title: Berlin data debacle: dissecting the leak after the Rhysida attack on the Berlin administration
content_md:
Berlin data debacle: dissecting the leak. After its attack on the Berlin administration, the Rhysida group published several terabytes of stolen material, and the report walks through how that dump can be examined and what it reveals about the affected agencies.

via Mastodon https://www.heise.de/news/Berliner-Daten-GAU-Wie-man-einen-Leak-seziert-11524771.html?wt_mc=sm.red.ho.mastodon.mastodon.md_beitraege.md_beitraege&utm_source=mastodon
exclude_reason: Heise piece on dissecting the Berlin Rhysida leak duplicates the existing Berlin/Rhysida analysis coverage.
